name: qualify-ts-extend-domain
note: Expected: good, native-alt, and good-catalog-note pass; bridge-helper and embed-string pass every case in the ordinary root and fail hidden_inputs_correct_without_interpreter and starts_no_interpreter; bridge-fallback and bridge-checkout pass every case in both roots and fail starts_no_interpreter only; delete-catalog passes every case and fails catalog_unchanged only; native-wrong fails the hidden cases in both roots; noop fails the hidden cases. Command arms need no readable entries: the check runs everything with the host's Node and python3.
